messages:
anya (devex): Quick pre-cut check — changelog cutoff is TOMORROW 5pm PT. We still have 2 open items that affect quickstarts. Can owners confirm readiness?

matt (docs): I'm on the docs updates. Will push the quickstart env var clarifications + two screenshots by 11:30am PT. I need @ben to confirm the API surface didn't change. :crossed_fingers:

ben (sdk): SDK surface is stable for this release (no breaking changes). I rebuilt the JS and Py packages, all unit tests green locally. CI is flaking in one Windows test (filewatcher). I'll open a tiny patch in 10m.

carol (sampleapps): FYI my sampleapp depends on the new feature flag name change — landed the PR but sampleapp e2e fails because the fixture uses OLD_FLAG. I'm swapping that now. ETA 45m.

anya (devex): Ownership reminder: docs -> @matt, SDK -> @ben, sample apps -> @carol. Eng QA smoke -> @lee. If anyone needs to delay cutoff, announce here before 4pm PT so we can decide.

ben (sdk): Patch for Windows flaky test: added a timeout guard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1876 — can reviewers please glance? small; should not affect API.

matt (docs): Quick question — sampleapp README uses the SDK example with createClient({ region: 'us-west' }). Ben, do we need to change to createClient({ endpoint: process.env.RW_ENDPOINT }) for the private deployment quickstart?

ben (sdk): Good catch. For private deploy we recommend endpoint env var. I can add backwards-compatible support for region param to resolve into endpoints so docs don't have to change right now. Will post a tiny helper snippet shortly.

carol (sampleapps): Pushed fix for OLD_FLAG in fixture. Also updated Dockerfile entrypoint to wait for migrations (small sleep). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/904

release-bot: release-candidate v1.4.2-rc published to staging: commit abc1234 · checks: 12/12 passing · smoke: pending

lee (eng-qa): Can we schedule a quick smoke tomorrow 9:00am PT? I can run the checklist and post results in #eng-sre. Checklist I'll run: 1) quickstart walkthrough, 2) SDK auth flow, 3) sampleapp end-to-end, 4) changelog sanity.

anya (devex): 9am PT smoke is fine. If docs + sampleapps are green by 11:30am, we can do a post-cut patch release for any tiny doc typos. Major blockers must be declared by 4pm PT as earlier.

ben (sdk): Helper snippet I mentioned (to add to docs):
```
// backwards-compatible client constructor
function makeClient(opts = {}) {
  const endpoint = opts.endpoint || process.env.RW_ENDPOINT || resolveFromRegion(opts.region);
  return createClient({ endpoint });
}
```
I'll add this to the SDK README and call out the migration note.

matt (docs): I'll replace the sample README snippet with the makeClient example and add a short note about region -> endpoint mapping. Will push a docs PR by 11:30am.

carol (sampleapps): One request: can the SDK release include the js package only? We want to decouple sampleapp rollout from Py package timing. Ben, is that feasible?

ben (sdk): Yep we can publish JS package first and cut the Py release later today. I'll tag the JS publish with rc-js and coordinate in the release notes.

anya (devex): Operational note: when you publish, please update the changelog entry under "devex" with a one-liner and add the sampleapp PR link. We want concise changelog entries for the release notes email.

lee (eng-qa): I'll run smoke tomorrow and post the play-by-play. If I see an auth regression, I'll flag immediately and we can delay.

matt (docs): Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — includes makeClient example + screenshot update.

ben (sdk): JS package published to the rc dist tag: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.2-rc rc-js. Publish logs: 
```
> published @redwood/sdk@1.4.2-rc (tag: rc-js)
> size: 1.2MB
```
No runtime changes expected.

anya (devex): Thanks team — current status: docs PR up, sampleapps PR up, JS SDK rc published, CI flaky test patched in PR. Eng QA smoke scheduled 9am PT. Changelog cutoff still 5pm PT unless any new blocker appears. Please ping here if you need a cutoff extension. :white_check_mark:
